news.title: PNB Housing Finance’s net profit rises 6% to ₹616.55 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: For the quarter ending September 30, 2026, PNB Housing Finance has reported a six percent increase in net profit. The company's total income also experienced a notable rise of 13.8 percent, amounting to ₹2,423.95 crore. The loan assets witnessed a significant growth of 19 percent, especially in the affordable market segments. Meanwhile, gross non-performing assets improved to 0.91 percent, bolstering overall financial stability.

news.title: Arkade Developers’ net profit declines 46% to ₹24.80 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Arkade Developers reported a striking 45.9 percent drop in net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, with total income falling by 44.6 percent compared to the prior fiscal year. Notably, collections saw a 22 percent rise year-on-year, reaching ₹183 crore. In the first half of FY27, net profit declined by 41.1 percent alongside a 31.3 percent decrease in total income.

news.title: Kreeva plans ₹5,000 crore expansion; targets two residential projects annually
news.para: Kreeva plans to invest ₹5,000 crore in residential developments across Delhi-NCR within the next four to five years. This strategy includes launching two new projects each year, targeting both luxury and multi-generational housing. Following recent successes with the Swaranaya project in South Delhi and another venture in Gurugram, Kreeva is also exploring options in Chandigarh and Lucknow, emphasizing ultra-luxury housing in chosen markets.

news.title: Trehan IRIS invests ₹400 crore to develop Greater Noida West mall
news.para: Trehan IRIS plans to make IRIS Broadway Greno West operational in Q1 2027. The company is investing ₹400 crore in the retail component and another ₹135 crore in a 135-room Courtyard by Marriott hotel at the mixed-use development. The mall is targeting annual retail consumption of over ₹580 crore in its first year, rising to around ₹700 crore in the second year.

news.title: India real estate private equity investment falls 31% to $1.66 billion in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Private equity investment in Indian real estate declined 31% year-on-year to $1.66 billion during January-September 2026, even as the number of transactions increased to 31 from 24. Domestic investors accounted for 85% of total investment, compared with 25% a year earlier.

news.title: India retail leasing rises 19% to 5.8 million sq ft in January-September 2026: Report
news.para: Retail space absorption across India reached about 5.8 million sq ft during January-September 2026, up around 19% year-on-year. Delhi-NCR, Mumbai and Hyderabad together accounted for nearly 67% of total leasing, while new retail supply stood at about 1.8 million sq ft.

news.title: Allahabad HC orders demolition of illegal towers at Ghaziabad's Gulmohar Greens
news.para: The Allahabad High Court has delivered a major verdict in the case concerning illegal construction at Gulmohar Greens Society in Ghaziabad. The Court has directed the Ghaziabad Development Authority (GDA) to completely demolish illegal Towers 27 and 28 of the society.

news.title: Draw of lots for second-phase house allotment at Wayanad township on October 31
news.para: On Saturday, the draw of lots for house allotment in Wayanad township will be conducted for beneficiaries. A total of 149 houses are set to be allocated to survivors of the Mundakkai-Chooralmala landslide. Efforts are being made to ensure all necessary services are ready by November when the houses are handed over. Additionally, a study will address rainwater stagnation in the area and resolve drainage issues.

news.title: Pune: Townships forced to depend on polluted Mula water in Hinjewadi
news.para: Residents living in expansive housing developments near Hinjewadi IT Park are voicing their fears regarding the polluted water supplied from the river. Persistent complaints about discolored, yellow-tinted water have been reported, despite initiatives from local authorities. The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board is currently engaged in talks to find resolutions while acknowledging that untreated sewage significantly contributes to the travesty.

news.title: Krisala, Hiranandani Communities plan township in Nagpur; Mahindra Lifespaces signs JDA for 10.05-acre Bengaluru land
news.para: Krisala Developers has partnered with Hiranandani Communities to create a golf course township in Nagpur. This township will encompass plotted developments, townhouses, villas, and an integrated golf course. Additionally, Mahindra Lifespace Developers has formed a joint development agreement for land in North Bengaluru. This agreement includes planned residential apartments with an estimated gross development value of ₹1,250 crore.

news.title: Bhubaneswar development body likely to extend deadline of Ekamra Residency application after poor response
news.para: The Bhubaneswar Development Authority may soon prolong the deadline for applications to the Ekamra Residency housing project, as it has garnered only 200 applications for 496 flats since its inception. Concerns over pricing have significantly impacted potential buyers, who find the costs to be steep in the current market. The BDA is reassessing the circumstances to better assist aspiring homeowners as they proceed.

news.title: Seven multi-storey buildings sealed, illegal structure razed in Gurugram sector 72
news.para: On Tuesday, the Department of Town and Country Planning displayed their zero-tolerance stance on illegal constructions in Gurgaon, sealing seven multi-storey buildings and tearing down an under-construction site in Sector 72. This decisive action was prompted by a surge in complaints about unauthorized constructions. Plans are already in motion for further demolitions to remove additional floors of the sealed structures, showcasing their dedication to maintaining regulatory standards in the area.

news.title: Ahmedabad development body sells three plots for ₹871 crore in three days
news.para: The Ahmedabad Urban Development Authority has successfully auctioned three prime plots, accumulating a staggering Rs 871.2 crore. Notably, a residential plot in Kathwada broke records by selling for Rs 697.5 crore. Additionally, a commercial plot in Thaltej achieved a remarkable price per square meter, showcasing robust demand in Ahmedabad's thriving real estate market. These sales indicate a strong confidence from corporate investors in the region's property landscape.

news.title: Navi Mumbai civic body issues notices to over 2,500 property tax defaulters
news.para: The Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation is intensifying its clampdown on property tax defaulters, serving notices to over 2,500 property owners. Under the leadership of Municipal Commissioner Kailash Shinde, the civic body sent 2,008 pre-seizure notices with a seven-day deadline and 507 notices with a 48-hour ultimatum. Impressively, 182 property owners have already cleared their dues, totaling Rs 14.

news.title: ACC’s net profit plunges 92% to ₹93 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: ACC, part of the Adani Group, experienced a 91.7 percent drop in net consolidated profit in Q2 FY27. The company's total income also fell by seven percent compared to the previous year. A total of 3.4 million tonnes per annum of cement capacity was added during this quarter. The shareholders approved the amalgamation with Ambuja Cements, set to streamline operations.

news.title: Homebuyer cannot wait indefinitely for possession of flat: Consumer court
news.para: A consumer court in Mumbai has ordered Soundlines Eco Homes to refund Rs 45.45 lakh to the buyer. The court found the builder guilty of deficiency in service after failing to deliver the flat. The promised possession date was December 31, 2016, but it was repeatedly delayed. The buyer expressed distress due to the builder's demands and lack of transparency about the construction.

news.title: Pune civic body's property tax registrations take a hit in FY27
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation has seen a sharp decline in new property tax registrations this financial year, largely due to staffing shortages exacerbated by Special Intensive Revision duties. Current statistics reveal that the number of processed properties for 2026-27 falls well below standards. With over 7,000 complaints filed, the limited staff has managed to resolve many.

news.title: Platinum Corp to invest ₹260 crore across four Mumbai residential projects
news.para: Platinum Corp plans to invest ₹260 crore across four residential developments in Mumbai’s western suburbs, with a combined projected GDV of over ₹1,350 crore. Of the total investment, ₹160 crore will come from institutional funding and ₹100 crore through internal accruals.
